text: Binary: from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP), 1 if at least one comment itself cites a specific real-world example in support of its point: an actual concrete case, event, person, organization, place, study instance, or the commenter's concrete personal experience (nonexhaustive examples; external verification not required). Invented, hypothetical, generic scenarios and purely abstract claims don't count; quotations of others count only if used as a specific real-world example. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither such an announcement nor an example. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies (including an empty list); null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.
